Patrick Hand SC, by Patrick Wagesreiter, copied unmodified from Google Fonts
on 2026-09-20 (Google Fonts serves version v17):

  https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Patrick+Hand+SC
  https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/patrickhandsc

  patrick-hand-sc-latin.woff2      the latin subset
  patrick-hand-sc-latin-ext.woff2  the latin-ext subset, for names such as
                                   Sámi and Göktürk

Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1, in OFL.txt beside this file.

Consumer: the map labels drawn on the canvas by js/globe.js, so the names
on the globe read as hand lettering on a chart. site.css declares the
@font-face; nothing else on the site uses the face.
